productDescription.message: Capture exactly what you need, explain clearly, and export with control.

unavailable.message: Visible area, region, element and full page are available.

visibleHint.message: What you see in the tab

selectHintRegion.message: Drag to choose a region · arrows move it (Ctrl resizes) · Enter captures · Esc cancels

selectHintElement.message: Click an element · ↑ parent · ↓ child · Enter captures · Esc cancels

selectIframe.message: Embedded frame: it can't be entered; the whole frame is captured

preferencesHint.message: Customize this foundation. Settings are saved only on this device.

openPreferencesHint.message: Opens the preferences available in M0

saveError.message: Could not save. Please try again.

languageHint.message: Chrome menus keep the browser language.

localOnly.message: All local. No accounts or analytics.

errorRestricted.message: This tab can't be captured. Chrome doesn't allow internal pages or the web store; open a regular web page and try again.

errorQuota.message: Chrome limits how often you can capture. Wait a second and try again.

errorBusy.message: A capture is already in progress. Wait for it to finish.

errorTabChanged.message: You switched tabs during the capture, so it was discarded to avoid mixing pages. Try again without switching tabs.

errorNoTab.message: No active tab found. Click a tab and try again.

errorTooLargeHint.message: It exceeds 8192 px per side or 33.2 million pixels. Reduce browser zoom or window size and try again.

errorFailed.message: Couldn't capture. Reload the page and try again.

errorFullPageTooLarge.message: This page is too long to capture in full. Try a region or the visible area.

discardHint.message: Removes the capture from this device

discardedHint.message: The capture was removed from this device. You can close this tab.

editorMissingHint.message: Temporary captures are kept for 24 hours on this device. Capture again from the extension icon.

canvasLabel.message: Captured image with annotations. Edit with a mouse or touch; PNG export includes every annotation.

redactNote.message: Redact replaces pixels with opaque black in the exported PNG.

exportError.message: Couldn't generate the PNG. Try again.
